ai.question: Is she likely to start a new patient on our therapy in the next 90 days?
ai.trainedOn: Two years of IQVIA prescriptions, claims counts, email engagement and call history, all already in Snowflake.
drivers: Peers in her practice already prescribing
ai.note: Dr O asked how her team should manage skin rash and colitis with immunotherapy in older patients. Wants something her infusion nurses can use.
ai.noteSource: Rep call note, Veeva CRM, 45 days ago
ai.ask: Which Texas oncologists raised side effect management this quarter but have not received the side effect guide?
ai.answer: 38 oncologists. 9 score above 0.7. Dr. Lena Ortiz ranks second.
ai.sql:
SELECT h.hcp_id, h.name, s.score
FROM gold.hcp h
JOIN ml.hcp_scores s USING (hcp_id)
JOIN ai.call_note_topics t USING (hcp_id)
WHERE h.state = 'TX'
  AND t.topic = 'Side effect management'
  AND h.hcp_id NOT IN (SELECT hcp_id FROM sfmc.sends
                       WHERE asset = 'side_effect_guide')
ORDER BY s.score DESC;
ai.scoreCaption: How likely she is to start a new patient in 90 days. Tells us who to focus on.

decide.sql:
SELECT action
FROM nba.options
WHERE consent_email = TRUE
  AND NOT already_received
  AND (action <> 'MSL_OUTREACH' OR has_medical_request)
decide.modelLine: Response model: gradient boosting, trained on 2 years of response history, registered in the Snowflake Model Registry.

email.label: SFMC email
email.conn: Marketing Cloud connector to the brand's SFMC business unit
steps: Snowflake's next best action for Dr. Ortiz is the side effect guide email.
Data 360 writes her and the chosen fields (name, specialty, interest) into a shared data extension in SFMC.
Journey Builder uses it as its entry source. Sent at 10:42 from the oncology brand team.
Subject: "Managing immune related side effects: a guide for your team", with the approved guide and Important Safety Information.
email.back: Sends, opens and clicks flow back to Data 360 through the Marketing Cloud data stream, then on to Snowflake.

web.label: Website
web.conn: Web tracking script plus Salesforce Personalization reading her live profile. Confirm the Personalization licence.
steps: Dr. Ortiz returns to the HCP website from the email link, so the site knows who she is.
As the page loads, Personalization asks Data 360 for her live profile.
It gets back: medical oncologist, interests efficacy and side effects, score 0.81.
The page leads with the side effect resources and the nurse webinar instead of the generic hero.
web.back: Nothing is sent ahead of time. The site asks about one person, at the moment she arrives. Her clicks stream back as new events.

identity.stewardNote: Exact rules prefer missing a link to making a wrong one. l.ortiz@houstononc.org does not match automatically; it is added to the golden record by data stewards if confirmed.
identity.r3Sql:
SELECT s.subscriber_key, g.hcp_id
FROM silver.sfmc s
JOIN gold.hcp_emails g
  ON LOWER(TRIM(s.email)) = g.email
WHERE g.email NOT LIKE 'info@%'
  AND g.email NOT LIKE 'office@%'
  AND g.email NOT LIKE 'admin@%';
